title: matricaria caucasica
intro: Matricaria caucasica, commonly known as Caucasian chamomile, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family. The health benefits of Matricaria caucasica include its use in reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its mild sedative and calming effects. Therapeutically, it acts as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it beneficial for wound healing, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Matricaria caucasica include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, particularly matricaria ester, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
